author: Eklip_Z
body:
Hello everyone!

So Cupcake here with a game that some may know already, it's called 'Yuck? Yum!' the point in this game is someone says a food of any kind from anywhere (remember to keep it mature,) and you post 'Yuck' or 'Yum' to show whether you like it or not. It's a pretty easy game so lets get started!


Start: Chicken Curry
